drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 45-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.51, bnp 42, creatinine 0.98, hemoglobin 14.7, platelets 317, sodium 139, wbc 6.8; vitals dbp 78-82, heart_rate 77-80, map 93-96, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 116-123, spo2 95-97, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Transthoracic echo: LVEF 63%, normal
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute systolic heart failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.98, hemoglobin 14.7, platelets 322, sodium 140, wbc 6.9; vitals dbp 77-82, heart_rate 78-81, map 91-95, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 116-123, spo2 95-97, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute systolic heart failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 45-year-old male, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute systolic heart failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
